provenance: Hand-authored for phase 7 step 7. Routes verified against artifact v0.7.1 with store.path() before the file was written; every case below was run, not assumed.
notes_on_composition: WHAT THIS SET IS FOR, AND IT IS NOT MORE PATH COVERAGE. gold_v0_1 already holds six path cases and
they score 100%. What gold does NOT hold is a single imperative query: all 38 of its cases begin
'Where did', 'Who influenced', 'What came out of' or 'How does'. The guided tour's own stated query
in SPEC.md section 1 is 'Take me from Detroit techno back to the blues.' So the phrasing the
showcase surface uses had never been evaluated once. That gap is this set.
TWO CASES ARE CONTROLLED PAIRS WITH GOLD AND THAT IS THE POINT. tour_v1_003 walks the same route as
gold_v0_1_017 and tour_v1_004 the same route as gold_v0_1_016. Same endpoints, same corpus, same
expected path -- the ONLY thing that differs is that the question is asked as an instruction. If a
live run ever scores the pair differently, the phrasing is the cause and nothing else can be.
EXPECTED_CLAIMS IS EMPTY ON EVERY CASE, DELIBERATELY, AND THE PRECEDENT IS IN GOLD ALREADY.
gold_v0_1_005 and gold_v0_1_010 carry no claims for the reason recorded there: under the split
contract claims are a required subset, and asserting particular edges needs the independent
non-Wikidata citations the gold set is built on -- real books with page numbers and ISBNs. Those
cannot be authored by an agent without fabricating them, and a project whose entire pitch is
checkable provenance cannot have invented citations in its own eval data. So these cases assert
that the phrasing RESOLVES and the corpus CAN answer, not what the answer is. Claim correctness on
these exact routes is already covered by gold_v0_1_016 and 017, which do carry citations.
THIS SET GATES NOTHING AND MUST NOT. thresholds.py:matches keys on dataset AND provider, so 'tour'
matches no ThresholdSet and gate() prints the loud NOT GATED banner. That is containment working,
not a defect: adding one case to a GATED live set trips _ungateable and costs $2.61 and ~2.4 hours
to restore. See phase-7-cinematic-surface-IMPLEMENTATION.md section 4.

cases.query: Take me from groove metal back to the blues.
cases.notes: The canonical surface C query, worded exactly as SPEC.md section 1 words it, and the route the shipped tour recording walks. CHOSEN IN STEP 8 FROM A RANKED LIST OF 20,095 CANDIDATE WALKS, not from taste: graph/routes.py scores every genre-to-genre walk of 2-6 hops on weakest edge tier, mean tier, corroboration and length. Five hops, three of them HAND-checked (groove metal <- thrash metal, heavy metal <- blues rock, blues rock <- blues) and two corroborated; only the two middle hops are INFOBOX_AUTO. It replaced Detroit techno -> Chicago house -> hip-hop -> rhythm and blues -> blues, which ranked 11,218th with every hop at the INFOBOX_AUTO floor and nothing corroborated. That earlier route was a step 5 taste pick and this step exists to catch exactly that.

cases.query: Walk me from dubstep to the music of Africa.
cases.notes: A different imperative verb, on purpose: 'walk me' rather than 'take me', so the set does not measure one phrasing and call it a category. Four hops: dubstep -> reggae -> rhythm and blues -> spirituals -> music of Africa. This is the project's thesis in one walk and is the strongest candidate step 8 inherits.

cases.query: Show me the path from Shibuya-kei to jazz.
cases.notes: CONTROLLED PAIR with gold_v0_1_017, which asks 'How is Shibuya-kei connected to jazz?' Same endpoints, same single hop, same corpus. The only variable is that this one is an instruction. A third imperative verb, and the shortest route in the set: one hop is the boring middle that .claude/rules/evals.md requires, and a one-hop tour is the case most likely to expose a pacing or camera assumption that only holds for longer walks.

cases.query: Take me from heavy metal back to the blues.
cases.notes: CONTROLLED PAIR with gold_v0_1_016, which asks 'How does heavy metal connect back to the blues?' Also the one case here whose route carries HAND-checked and independently cited edges in gold, so a divergence between this case and its pair cannot be blamed on thin evidence. Note the query says 'heavy metal' while the node is labelled 'heavy metal music': the trailing-music fold in label_key is load-bearing here and this case is now the thing that notices if it regresses.

cases.query: Take me from trip hop to jazz.
cases.notes: Two hops through hip-hop. Included as an ordinary middle: the set would otherwise be two four-hop showpieces, a one-hop minimum and a refusal, with nothing in between.

cases.query: Take me from delta blues to Detroit techno.
cases.notes: THE REFUSAL CASE, AND IT IS THE ROUTE THIS PROJECT ADVERTISED FOR SIX WEEKS. SPEC.md section 1, the phase 7 scope doc and the step 5 plan all offered 'take me from delta blues to Detroit techno' until 2026-09-09, when it was measured and found to have no path in either direction and no undirected connection either. Delta blues sits in a two-node influence component with Chicago blues and has no sourced parents at all; Detroit techno sits in the 534-node one. Both nodes RESOLVE, which is exactly why the dead route looked plausible for so long -- this is the resolved-but-unconnected refusal, the stronger of the two refusal shapes. Without this case the set would refuse nothing and refusal accuracy would have no true refusal to measure. It is also the permanent record: if a future corpus connects these two, this case fails and someone re-reads the phase 8 decision rather than quietly reviving a retired claim.
